# What do you owe on this quarter's EU OSS return?

> Free EU VAT OSS calculator: EUR 10,000 threshold check and the quarterly OSS return by country and rate from a sales CSV.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/eu-vat-oss-calculator/)
